restoration_note: The teaching has two main movements. (2) Ch.98 contrasts virgin (light untouched by mingling) with continent (light mingled then chosen out and stood again), running this distinction through cosmic, inner-rational, and outer-fleshly registers. The horticultural section is heavily formulaic, and editor proposals there (ⲕⲁⲣⲡⲟⲥ, ⲡⲗⲁⲥⲥⲉ, ⲉⲛⲑⲩⲙⲏⲥⲓⲥ, ⲕⲗⲁⲁⲟⲥ, ⲛⲟⲩⲛⲉ, ⲕⲟⲩⲟⲩⲛϥ̄, etc.) are confirmed by the recurring Manichaean diction. Ch.98's parallel formulae about 'tasting death' and 'coming to the war of the Enemy' constrain {115}, {131}, {132}, {136} with high confidence. The opening {0-1} headline, the long fragmentary middle of ch.97 (lines 13-25), and the closing dragon teaching (ch.100, {158-159}) are too damaged for principled fills and are marked unrestorable.
